title: Introduce compact form row layout and inline validation summary
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Product teams are building dense configuration panels and admin UIs that require tighter vertical rhythm and clearer inline validation than our current form rows allow. Existing components are optimized for roomy product surfaces; squeezing them causes inconsistent spacing, duplicated helper text, and validation noise.

Goal: Add a compact form-row variant and an inline validation summary mode that: (1) reduces vertical spacing while preserving touch/click targets, (2) surfaces one-line inline errors and an optional summary banner, (3) reuses design tokens so theming and contrast requirements remain consistent, and (4) provides a clear migration path for existing usages.

Outcomes (acceptance criteria):
- New FormRow prop compressed=true that reduces vertical padding and collapses helper/error rows while keeping the label readable.
- Input primitives (TextField, Select, Toggle) accept compressed=true and have documented token mappings.
- Inline validation summary: small red single-line messages for per-field errors and an optional top-level summary with count + anchor links.
- Accessibility: label associations, live region announcements for error messages, 4.5:1 contrast for error text where required.
- Tokens: spacing scale tokens consumed via components (spacing.form.row-compact -> 8px top/bottom), and a new token for compact helper font-size.
- Migration guide and 1-2 example pages (Billing settings, Admin bulk edits) implemented in Storybook and verified by QA.

Design notes:
- Use token spacing.form.row-compact = 8 and spacing.form.row-default = 16.
- Helper text compression reduces from 12px -> 11px, with line-height preserved to avoid clipping.
- Error state uses color.semantic.error-600 and a subtle icon (12px) inline to the left of text in compact mode.

API proposal (component props):
- FormRow: compressed: boolean, validationMode: "inline" | "summary" | "none" (default: "inline")
- TextField/Select/Toggle: compressed: boolean, showHelperOnFocusOnly: boolean (optional)

Migration plan:
1) Design system exposes compressed prop and tokens.
2) Update internal storybook with examples (billing, admin).
3) Outreach: create a migration doc and notify product teams via #design-systems with sample PRs.
4) Engineering rollout: enable flag gated rollout (console feature flag) to flip component default in selected routes.

Testing and QA checklist:
- Storybook: compressed stories, all validation permutations.
- Keyboard: tab order, focus ring behavior in compact rows.
- Screen reader: NVDA/VoiceOver announces error text and summary update.
- Cross-browser: ensure no clipping on Safari iOS (small font issues).
- Visual regression: Percy/Chromatic snapshots for compact vs default.

Out-of-scope: redesign of floating labels or helper-affix behaviours (handled in separate tickets).

notes: Suggested rollout path: enable compressed only for internal admin apps first (low-risk), collect telemetry on error rates and help reopenings. Add analytics event: ds.form.compressed_enabled = true/false. Refer to ENG-7182 token delivery schedule.
risks: Small typography changes at compact sizes can reduce legibility on older devices; ensure QA covers low-DPI and zoom scenarios. Also consider performance impact of additional DOM anchors for summary mode on very large forms.
